notes: lightkurve reads a mission's own light curve file as it is: the PDC-MAP flux of a K2 campaign or of a TESS 2-minute sector.
astropy's LombScargle is the generalized periodogram of Reinhold & Hekker (2020).
star-privateer computes the wavelet power spectrum and the autocorrelation of a light curve: two of the three period methods of Reinhold & Hekker (2020), whose criteria methods.mts applies.

SpinSpotter measures a rotation period from a light curve's autocorrelation and describes its peaks: the method of Holcomb et al. (2022) for TESS 2-minute light curves, whose criteria methods.mts applies.
lightkurve warns that its pixel-response model needs oktopus; that part is not used.
